verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser exposes a fully documented REST API (Scrape, Crawl, Extract, Sessions, Agents) plus official SDKs and a CLI, all covered in detailed first-party docs, and community comments confirm real developers have used the API/docs (even correcting a code sample). Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent third-party validation of full API completeness.
